messages.subject: ggmap level of detail
parts:
Hi all,

Thanks to Hadley for David Kahle for a truly wonderful package — ggmap is amazing . . .
But I noticed when mapping directions that the number of legs and level of detail is lower than when requesting the same info manually from the maps.google website. Through the website, both walking and directions for the example below neatly follow the A3 highway, but the ggmap code generates a rougher line. str() shows that both the Route and Leg files have only a few nodes. Am I missing a setting for greater detail?

Mark
Dept of History


rm(list = ls())

library("ggmap", lib.loc="/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library")
library("ggplot2", lib.loc="/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library")


Kenya.Sat <- get_map('Kenya', maptype = c("terrain"), zoom=7) 


Route <- route(from='Nairobi', to='Garissa',
                 mode = "walking",
                 structure="route",
                 output = "simple", alternatives = FALSE,
                 messaging = FALSE, sensor = FALSE,
                 override_limit = FALSE)

Legs <- route(from='Nairobi', to='Garissa',
              mode = "walking",
              structure="leg",
              output = "simple", alternatives = FALSE,
              messaging = FALSE, sensor = FALSE,
              override_limit = FALSE)

ggmap(Kenya.Sat) + 
  geom_path(data=Route, aes(x = lon, y = lat), color="red")

ggmap(Kenya.Sat) + 
  geom_leg(data=Legs, aes(x = startLon, y = startLat, xend = endLon, yend = endLat), color="red")
